description: The effective Dynamic DNS settings: each value, the fields an environment variable sets, and when a change takes effect

period.description: How often the dynamic DNS records are checked, a time from 1m to 24h such as 5m or 1h30m (env DDNS_PERIOD); a change restarts the timer

cooldown.description: The shortest time between two changes of one record, a time from 1m to 24h (env DDNS_COOLDOWN)

ipv4_services.description: The services asked for the instance's public IPv4 address, https:// URLs; a new list needs at least 2, since a new address counts only when a second service confirms it (a stored list of one is kept while a save leaves it unchanged); a literal address the server may not call, or a name that resolves to one, is refused (env DDNS_IPV4_SERVICES)

ipv6_services.description: The services asked for the instance's public IPv6 address, https:// URLs; a new list needs at least 2, since a new address counts only when a second service confirms it (a stored list of one is kept while a save leaves it unchanged); a literal address the server may not call, or a name that resolves to one, is refused (env DDNS_IPV6_SERVICES)

resolver.description: DNS servers the updater asks for a record's current address, IPv4 addresses or IPv6 addresses in brackets with an optional :port; empty uses the container's own resolvers (env DDNS_RESOLVER)

locked.description: Fields that cannot be changed because an environment variable sets them (see locked_by). A save ignores them (read only)

locked_by.description: For each locked field, the environment variable that sets it (read only)

period.description: Name of the variable that locks the period: DDNS_PERIOD

cooldown.description: Name of the variable that locks the cooldown: DDNS_COOLDOWN

ipv4_services.description: Name of the variable that locks the ipv4 services: DDNS_IPV4_SERVICES

ipv6_services.description: Name of the variable that locks the ipv6 services: DDNS_IPV6_SERVICES

resolver.description: Name of the variable that locks the resolver: DDNS_RESOLVER

locked_reason.description: Always empty: no field of this section is locked by the variable of another setting

applies.description: When a change of each field takes effect

period.description: When a change of the period takes effect: on save, without a reload

cooldown.description: When a change of the cooldown takes effect: on save, without a reload

ipv4_services.description: When a change of the ipv4 services takes effect: on save, without a reload

ipv6_services.description: When a change of the ipv6 services takes effect: on save, without a reload

resolver.description: When a change of the resolver takes effect: on save, without a reload

restart_pending.description: Always empty: every Dynamic DNS setting applies without a container restart
